That failure is a feature, but it is not free: it cost 90 minutes of darkness because an aborted loop must wait for the next cron, and at 6% cron acceptance that is the standing price of fail-loud. UPTIME IS STILL THE UNFIXED FAULT AND IT IS DAY THREE. The escalation condition I recorded on 08-13 is unchanged - an external trigger is the only lever left. ONE NEW CONCERN, no alert: congress emptied its entire 600 dollars of idle cash into six legs from a single filer on a single 08-07 disclosure, and its own log scores that filer at '+0.0% avg excess'. It is now 100% invested with every leg locked to 2026-11-11 and no stop, and three of the six are down hard on day two (AVGO -3.98%, ADBE -2.99%, CSCO -1.72%). THE GROK WATCHER IS DARK 171 HOURS, unchanged, but its damage is now bounded rather than silent - the owner turned its staleness into an action instead of a blind spot. Consequence to watch: the hype bot is 100% cash and cannot re-enter while the scan is stale, so its R4 dead-money clock starts today at day 1.

Worth flagging only because it compounds the uptime fault: a guard trip now buys darkness.
